'''Muthoot Microfin Limited'''<ref>{{Cite web|title=Home - Muthoot Microfin |url=https://muthootmicrofin.com/ |access-date=2022-04-19 |language=en-US}}</ref> is an Indian [[microfinance]] institution (MFI), headquartered in [[Kochi]]. It primarily provides [[unsecured debt|unsecured]] [[microloans]] to women in rural areas.<ref>{{cite news |title=Our aim is to provide financial support to disadvantaged women: Sadaf Sayeed, Muthoot Microfin |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/money/our-aim-is-to-provide-financial-support-to-disadvantaged-women-sadaf-sayeed-muthoot-microfinance-2404137/ |access-date=18 December 2023 |work=Financial Express |date=1 February 2022 |language=en}}</ref> It is a part of [[Muthoot Pappachan Group]].<ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-12-06 |title=Muthoot Microfin gets $50 million equity funding from GPC |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/muthoot-microfin-gets-50-million-equity-funding-from-gpc/article37874522.ece |access-date=2022-04-19 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=Bhatla |first=Prabhjeet |title=Muthoot Microfin Raises INR 75 Cr Via Market-Linked Debentures |url=https://www.entrepreneur.com/article/377374 |access-date=2022-04-19 |website=Entrepreneur |date=15 July 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-07-15 |title=Muthoot Microfin raises Rs75 crore via market-linked debentures |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/muthoot-microfin-raises-rs75-crore-via-market-linked-debentures-11626334286312.html |access-date=2022-04-19 |website=livemint |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=October 3, 2022 |title=Muthoot Microfin secures USD 10 mn from Greater Pacific Capital |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/muthoot-microfin-secures-usd-10-mn-from-greater-pacific-capital/articleshow/94625358.cms |access-date=2022-10-17 |website=The Times of India |language=en}}</ref>

== History ==
The microfinance business was originally established as a division of Muthoot Fincorp Limited in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rating Rationale |url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/MuthootMicrofinLimited_June%2011,%202021_RR_272877.html |access-date=2023-04-05 |website=www.crisil.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=SEBI |url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/jul-2018/1533016080994.pdf}}</ref> In December 2011, the Muthoot Pappachan Group acquired Pancharatna Securities Ltd, a non-banking financial company (NBFC) based in Mumbai, and subsequently rebranded it as Muthoot Microfin Limited (MML).<ref name=":4">{{Cite news |title=Muthoot Microfin Limited |work=[[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] |url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/jul-2018/1533016080994.pdf |access-date=14 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Muthoot Microfin enters digital healthcare; To offer E-clinic services in rural India to its customers |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/healthcare/news-healthcare/muthoot-microfin-enters-digital-healthcare-to-offer-e-clinic-services-in-rural-india-to-its-customers/2454945/ |access-date=2022-07-08 |website=Financialexpress |date=9 March 2022 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-09 |title=Muthoot Microfin to offer healthcare in rural India via e-clinics |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/muthoot-microfin-to-offer-healthcare-in-rural-india-via-eclinics-11646814119311.html |access-date=2022-07-08 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref>

In March 2015, Muthoot Microfin Limited (MML) obtained a microfinance institution (MFI) license as a non-banking financial company (NBFC-MFI) from the [[Reserve Bank of India]].<ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite news |last=Rebello |first=Joel |title=Muthoot Microfin looking at listing in March |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/muthoot-microfin-looking-at-listing-in-march/articleshow/68211589.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2022-04-19}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Ray |first=Atmadip |title=UK's Greater Pacific to invest $10 m in Muthoot Microfin |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/greater-pacific-capital-to-raise-its-stake-in-muthoot-microfin-to-16/articleshow/94156758.cms |access-date=2022-10-18}}</ref>

In 2021, Muthoot Microfin Ltd launched Mahila Mitra app to help rural women beneficiaries with repayment.<ref name="Shantanu2021">{{Cite web|last=Shantanu |first=Shashank |date=2021-08-25 |title=How this microfinance firm is empowering women entrepreneurs in rural India with an app |url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/business/news-muthoot-microfinance-mahila-mitra-app-empowering-women-entrepreneurs-in-rural-india-729042 |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=www.indiatvnews.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title= Muthoot Microfin News & Analysis|publisher= NDTV.com |date=2024|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/muthoot-microfin-ltd/stocks/companyid-53100.cms}}</ref>

== Operations ==
Muthoot Microfin operates in 18 states with 1,172 branches and over 10,000 employees.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-07-01 |title=Muthoot Microfin riles revised IPO papers to raise Rs 1,350 crore |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/business-economy/markets/muthoot-microfin-riles-revised-ipo-papers-to-raise-rs-1350-crore-article-101418675 |access-date=2023-09-04 |website=TimesNow |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-11-09 |title=Muthoot Pappachan Group plans Rs 1,800-cr IPO for MFI arm |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/muthoot-pappachan-group-plans-rs-1800-cr-ipo-for-mfi-arm/articleshow/95396123.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-09-04 |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> As of March 31, 2023, Muthoot Microfin has a portfolio size of {{INR}}9,200 crore with a borrower base of 2.7 million women entrepreneurs.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-06-05 |title=Muthoot Microfin to provide loan in 30 minutes through app |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/muthoot-microfin-to-provide-loan-in-30-minutes-through-app/articleshow/100761218.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-09-04 |issn=0971-8257}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-07 |title=Muthoot Microfin clocks ₹203 crore profit for FY23 |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/muthoot-microfin-clocks-203-crore-profit-for-fy23/article66822719.ece |access-date=2023-09-04 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

== Ownership ==
Muthoot Microfin is predominantly owned by [[Muthoot Fincorp]] and the Muthoot family, who collectively possess a controlling stake of 71% in the company. In addition, London-based private equity firm GPC (Greater Pacific Capital) holds an ownership interest of 16.6%,<ref name=":2">{{Cite news |last=Ray |first=Atmadip |date=2021-12-07 |title=Greater Pacific acquires 14% in Muthoot Microfin |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/private-equity-fund-greater-pacific-capital-buys-around-14-in-muthoot-microfin-for-50-mn/articleshow/88127300.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-08-26 |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2022-10-03 |title=Muthoot Microfin secures $10 mn from Greater Pacific Capital |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/muthoot-microfin-secures-10-mn-from-greater-pacific-capital-9272781.html |access-date=2023-08-26 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite news |last=Ray |first=Atmadip |date=2022-09-13 |title=UK's Greater Pacific to invest $10 m in Muthoot Microfin |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/greater-pacific-capital-to-raise-its-stake-in-muthoot-microfin-to-16/articleshow/94156758.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-08-26 |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> while Chicago-based private equity fund Creation Investments Capital Management holds 9.3%.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=Muthoot Microfin to raise Rs 130 cr from Creation Investments |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/pti-feed/story/muthoot-microfin-to-raise-rs-130-cr-from-creation-investments-862674-2017-01-24 |access-date=2023-08-26 |website=India Today |date=24 January 2017 |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |date=2017-01-25 |title=Muthoot Pappachan Group raises Rs 130 cr from Chicago-based PE fund Creation Investments |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/muthoot-pappachan-group-raises-rs-130-cr-from-chicagobased-pe-fund/article9501915.ece |access-date=2023-08-26 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>
